turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Alex calling from Maple Bank. This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: May I speak with Maxime Lussier?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Speaking.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Before we continue, can you please confirm your date of birth?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, it's [PII].

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks. Is this still the best number to reach you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, this is my cell.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I'm calling about your account with Maple Bank, which is past due.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The amount past due today is $228.87.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'm not able to pay that right now. We were evacuated because of the wildfire in Apr.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Stop calling me every day! This is harassment.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: We had to leave our house because of the fire.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. We have hardship options, like a reduced payment for three months. Would you like me to review that with you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that would help.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'll make a note on the file so the hardship team can review you're situation.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You should hear from them within a few business days.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'll try to pay $195 the 15th.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Just to confirm, a payment of $195.00 on August 15. I'll send you a payment link.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Will you be paying through the app or online banking?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Through the app.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Perfect.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Before I transfer you, we can also set up a payment plan.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for your time today. You'll receive a confirmation by text. Have a good evening.
